title: FHFA House Price Index — monthly index (May 2027), 9:00 a.m. ET
source: FHFA: two FHFA primaries fetched direct 2026-09-08 by this session, independently of the sweep that proposed this id. (1) fhfa.gov/data/hpi (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes) — its "2027 HPI Release Dates" table reads "Tuesday, July 27 | Monthly Index | May 2027", the seventh of twelve dated 2027 rows (Jan 26 -> Dec 28, every one a last Tuesday). (2) The published 2026Q2 report (HTTP 200, 1,522,949 bytes, released 2026-08-25; 517 stream objects located, 511 inflated in-session with node zlib), whose "FHFA HPI Release Dates for 2027" appendix page carries the identical row above the statement: "Public FHFA HPI(R) releases occur at 9AM ET and include a press release, tables, figures, and associated data" — a published document, not a second reading of the same web table, and the source of the 9:00 a.m. ET time. THE EDITION TYPE IS QUOTED, NOT INFERRED: the same table marks exactly four 2027 rows "Quarterly Index (with Monthly Tables)" — February 23, May 25, August 31 and November 30 — so this is a monthly edition by the publisher's own labelling. Promoted estimate -> confirmed on the precedent fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24, fhfa-hpi-2026-12-29, fhfa-hpi-2027-01-26, fhfa-hpi-2027-02-23, fhfa-hpi-2027-08-31 and fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30 set: the no-self-confirm limit binds the DISCOVERING sweep (fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30), not this event's own independent second look, and FHFA: is a confirmed-tier prefix in market-events-data.ts describing exactly this pair of documents. notes: PROPOSED by the fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30 initial-research sweep (2026-09-08) as one of five untracked 2027 rows; researched the same day, and the proposal file is now shadowed by this canonical one. INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-08 (docs/research/events/fhfa-hpi-2027-07-27.md) NARROWS TWO SIBLING FINDINGS ON THE SAME DATE. (1) THE BLACKOUT IS REAL BUT JULY'S IS NOT THE ONE THE CHAIN MEASURED. All 56 posted FOMC meeting pairs were re-parsed from federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (HTTP 200, 164,828 bytes, "Last Update: August 19, 2026") and every blackout re-derived from the Board's own rule; July 2027 is posted 07-27/07-28 (NON-SEP), the window runs 2027-07-17 -> 2027-07-29, and this print is FOMC DAY ONE — July is 7 of 7 on both counts across 2021-2027, the same structural class as January. The pooled blackout regime reproduces (VIX9D/VIX 0.9887 vs 0.9067, p=0.0000, n=400 vs 1,025). BUT JULY-MEETING BLACKOUT SESSIONS DO NOT CARRY IT: 0.9530 vs 0.9277 against all other sessions is NULL at p=0.1323, and against OTHER blackout sessions July reads 0.9530 vs 0.9970 at p=0.0063 — the flattest blackout in the panel, where October's signature is steepening (p=0.0652 here) and December's is range compression (1.03 vs 1.59, p=0.0169). A lane importing the pooled blackout number onto this date would be importing a regime July refutes. (2) THE JANUARY SIBLING'S 'HOT RELEASE SESSION' READING DOES NOT TRANSFER, THOUGH THE STRUCTURE IS IDENTICAL. All six July releases since 2021 are monthly editions, in a blackout, on FOMC day one — the cleanest matched sample any FHFA ledger has had — and they printed SPX |c2c| 0.471 / 1.154 / 0.281 / 0.496 / 0.296 / 0.210%, median 0.384% against 0.413% for all 67 releases (p=0.8851) and ONE of six above the 1.1122% release-day p75, against January's two of five and April's three of six. July is the quietest of the four blackout months at daily resolution. (3) THE CHAIN'S ONE LIVE INTRADAY FINDING SURVIVES POOLED AND DISSOLVES ON THIS DATE'S CLASS. The clean 09:00-09:30 ET bar reproduces the 11-30 sibling exactly (34 release mornings, monthly n=22 at 2.54 vs 8.59 bps p=0.0211, quarterly n=12 at 6.34 p=0.4753) — but split on FOMC day-one membership the monthly quiet is null in this date's half (n=9, 3.66 vs 8.59, p=0.2010) and the two halves are indistinguishable from each other (p=0.4888), which is a power statement, not a refutation. Meanwhile NON-RELEASE day-one mornings are LOUD (15.30 vs 8.57 bps, n=14, p=0.0370): two measured effects of opposite sign collide on this date and the nine historical collisions resolve toward the quiet side without separating. (4) CONTENT: the restatement panel was rebuilt independently — 50 archived report PDFs downloaded, 49 parsed, 190 U.S.-column revision observations, n=40 first restatements — and reproduces the 11-30 sibling's headline including its two named exceptions by name (median 0.100pp, mean 0.065, max 0.200, 16/40 unchanged, ZERO sign flips, and the only two positive priors restated to <=0 are 2024-03 and 2025-02, both +0.1% -> 0.0%; quarterly vs monthly p=1.0000). THE NEW CUT ANSWERS NO: |first restatement| does not scale with the size of the print being restated (Spearman rho -0.1375, p=0.3993; large vs small p=0.3378), and when a first restatement moves at all it pushes the printed m/m AWAY from zero 17 times against 7 toward it (exact binomial p=0.0639). SEASONAL NOT RE-OPENED per the proposer's instruction — May is reported as context only (13/15 positive since 2012, median +0.464%, p=0.8943). Corridor fully tracked already: consumer-confidence-2027-07-27 at 10:00 the same morning and fomc-2027-07-28 the next, and the derived blackout start 2027-07-17 matches the standing proposals/fomc-blackout-start-2027-07-17 to the day — NO new proposal was warranted and none is filed.
